description: Search RIGShare's rental equipment marketplace by filters. Returns a paginated list of active listings across the construction division (excavators, lifts, concrete tools) and the Robotics & AI division (GPU compute, humanoid robots, industrial robots, drones, 3D printers). Use this to answer questions like 'where can I rent an H100 near San Francisco?' or 'find a humanoid robot under $200/day'. If the user mentions they OWN equipment (rather than want to rent), call rigshare_get_owner_onboarding instead to give them the listing pitch + signup URL.

access_type.description: How renters connect to a remote-access listing; matches remote-access listings only.

category.description: Exact category value, e.g. AI_COMPUTE or EXCAVATORS; rigshare_list_categories returns the values that currently have listings. Overrides division. An unknown value is an error.

city.description: Exact city name, case-insensitive. There is no radius search.

compute_architecture.description: Accelerator family of an AI compute listing.

division.description: Division to search (default all). Ignored when category is set.

max_price_daily_usd.description: Upper bound on the listing's daily rate, in USD.

min_price_daily_usd.description: Lower bound on the listing's daily rate, in USD.

remote_only.description: true = only listings rented over the network (AI compute, AI infrastructure and IoT sensor listings).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the listing title only (not the description, make/model or location).

sort.description: Default newest. price_asc / price_desc sort by daily rate; rating = highest average rating first.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX (exact match).

name: rigshare_search_equipment
title: Search equipment
